legacyClosures.gate: The gate is `pokemon.getHpRatio() <= 1 / 3`, and getHpRatio() rounds the ratio to two decimals (round(hp / max * 100) / 100), so at 33.4 percent HP it passes. hp.at-most (exact) tests hp * 100 <= max * 33 and fails there, and floor-half differs again; no atom calls the game's rounded ratio. Requested as R-B16-11 (hp.ratio-at-most) in requests/B16.md.
